## Event Timeline
Event Period: September 2, 04:00 (UTC) - September 23, 03:59 (UTC)
## Card Collection Phase 1
September 2, 04:00 (UTC) - September 9, 03:59 (UTC)
## Card Collection Phase 2
September 9, 04:00 (UTC) - September 16, 03:59 (UTC)
## Card Collection Phase 3
September 16, 04:00 (UTC) - September 23, 03:59 (UTC)
## Team Creation / Registration
Captain Registration: September 2, 04:00 (UTC) - September 8, 03:59 (UTC)
## Team Competition Period
September 9, 04:00 (UTC) - September 23, 03:59 (UTC)
## Oracle Cards Rules
## Card Collection Prize Pool
1. Complete daily tasks such as Futures trading to earn card draws. Collect all six O, U, R, B, I, and T cards to complete one card set and qualify to share the prize pool.
2. Each phase features a 100,000 USDT prize pool, for a total of 300,000 USDT across 3 phases.
3. Individual Reward = (Number of Card Sets Completed by the User ÷ Total Card Sets Completed by All Users) × Prize Pool for the Current Phase.
4. During each card collection phase, users must reach at least 50,000 USDT in Futures trading volume to qualify for the prize pool.
## Random Card Draw Rewards
1. Every draw guarantees one card, with a chance to receive additional surprise rewards such as USDT, Futures Bonus, and more, from a total prize pool worth 200,000 USDT.
## Futures Team Showdown Rules
## Competition Format
1. Teams will compete based on Futures trading volume. The top 50 teams in the final rankings will share a prize pool of up to 2,500,000 USDT.
2. Once the competition begins, the system will track the Futures trading volume of all participants in real time. The prize pool will be progressively unlocked based on the overall trading progress, up to a maximum of 2,500,000 USDT.
## Team Formation Rules
1. Each team must have at least 5 members, including the captain, to be successfully formed and participate in the competition.
2. Teams with fewer than 5 members before the competition begins will be automatically disbanded, and their members will be reassigned to other teams by the system.
3. Users who register during the competition must manually select a team by 15:59 (UTC) on the day of registration. Otherwise, the system will randomly assign them to a team.
## Team Types
1. Open Team: Any user can join freely.
2. Private Team: Users must enter the password set by the captain to join.
3. Once a team is successfully formed, the captain cannot disband the team, and members cannot leave.
## Reward Distribution
Captain Share: 20% of the winning team's reward
## Member Reward Distribution:
Rank | Reward Share
1st | 20%
2nd | 15%
3rd | 10%
4th and Below | The remaining 35% will be distributed based on each member's share of the team's trading volume, capped at 10% per person.
## Eligibility Requirement
During the event, each user must reach at least 50,000 USDT in Futures trading volume to qualify for rewards.
## Terms & Conditions
1. Users must register on the event page to participate and receive rewards.
2. Sub-accounts and Market Maker accounts don't qualify. Sub-account trading volume will not be counted toward the main account.
3. Daily card draw tasks reset at 15:59 (UTC).
4. TradFi trading tasks only count Futures trading volume from Commodities, US Stocks, Forex, and Stock Index with non-zero fees.
5. Random draw rewards will be distributed immediately upon winning, within 24 hours at the latest.
6. Card Collection and Team Showdown rewards will be credited to winning Ourbit accounts within 7 business days after the event concludes.
7. Only on-chain deposits made during the event count towards Deposit Tasks. Internal transfers and Ourbit wallet transfers are excluded.
8. Only USDT-M Futures trades on Ourbit count. Position Vouchers, stablecoin pairs (e.g., USDC/USDT), and copy trades are not included.
9. The validity of Futures Bonus, Position Voucher, Liquidation Coverage Voucher, and Fee Deduction Voucher is subject to the Voucher Center terms.
10. Ourbit reserves the right to disqualify users engaging in wash trading, matched trading, multi-account operations, or self-trading.
11. Users found to be replicating identical trading strategies across multiple accounts will be disqualified.
12. Users detected frequently placing and canceling orders within the same minute will be disqualified.
13. If multiple accounts are detected operating from the same IP address, all users under that IP will be disqualified.
14. Ourbit reserves the final right of interpretation for all event rules, including but not limited to risks arising from trading, funding, and coordinated group behavior.
